messages.subject: Monta | Director-Level Corporate Affairs, ESG & Government Relations Executive | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Zaķe,

I am reaching out because your role as Group Head of People at Eleving Group makes you a relevant contact for senior international profiles spanning corporate affairs, government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships and regulated-market leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. This combination aligns well with an international financial group operating across multiple markets and regulatory environments.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached an Eleving Group-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for relevant current or future mandates across the Group or referral to the appropriate business leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
